'''Luigi Amerio''' (15 August 1912 – 28 September 2004), was an Italian [[electrical engineer]] and [[mathematician]]. He is known for his work on [[almost periodic function]]s, on [[Laplace transform]]s in one and several dimensions, and on the theory of [[elliptic partial differential equation]]s.

==Works==
A selection of Luigi Amerio's scientific papers is published in the two volumes of his "''Selecta''" {{harv|Amerio|1990}}: he is also the author of several university textbooks and, jointly with his pupil [[Giovanni Prouse]], he wrote the influential monograph on almost periodic functions {{harv|Amerio|Prouse|1971}}.
